title: Section contract (sections/*.json)
description: Closed shape of one section contract. It separates three things that used to be conflated: PROVENANCE (source: where the section comes from in the built clone, traceable to a component file, a mount line and a DOM selector), TAXONOMY (semantic: the stable id a generator uses and the closed category it is filed under) and RETRIEVAL ELIGIBILITY (retrievalEligible). source and semantic are closed objects: a field not listed here is rejected. Machine-checked by extraction/verify_all.py (check O); the semanticId must equal the contract id, the categories must equal tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json sectionCategories, and retrievalEligible is compared against a pin kept independently of this file.

sourceId.description: Name of the thing in the source project that implements this section (the component or page element). Provenance only: never used as a generator-facing id.

citation.description: path:line of the declaration, resolved and content-checked against the source by verify_all.py through the ledger.

mountedAt.description: path:line where the source mounts it (the route / App composition).

domSelectors.description: CSS selectors locating the rendered section in the built page; extraction/measure_sections.mjs measures the union span of the matches.

inFlow.description: false for position:fixed overlays, which have no height in the page flow and are never height-gated.

category.description: Closed taxonomy. HERO sections are subject to the whole-page-wrapper height gate in verify_all.py (check P).

retrievalEligible.description: true for page content. false for utility overlays (overlay.cookie-banner, overlay.demo-dialog), pinned independently of this file.
